retrieval_timestamp_limit: Dynamic issuer and Base-market pages did not expose a consistent retrieval timestamp. Displayed page refresh times are retained with timezone uncertainty. This artifact is a point-in-time research reconciliation, not a synchronized market feed.

sbi_holdings.role: Parent/investor across banking, securities, digital assets and venture affiliates.

sbi_shinsei_bank.role: SBI Group bank; separate legal entity from SBI Holdings and from regional SBIC companies.

sbi_shinsei_trust_bank.role: Issuer of the JPYSC yen stablecoin; shareholding described as 51% SBI Shinsei Bank and 49% SBI Holdings in SBI Group restructuring materials.

sbi_vc_trade.role: SBI Holdings consolidated subsidiary; distributes XRP, RLUSD, USDC and JPYSC-related services.

sbi_ripple_asia.role: SBI/Ripple cross-border payment and ledger initiative; an SBI investor presentation reports 60% SBI and 40% Ripple ownership.

startale_group.role: Co-development partner for JPYSC; SBI Group describes it as an equity-method affiliate.

sbic_east_central_west.role: Not aliases for SBI Holdings, SBI Shinsei Bank, SBI Shinsei Trust Bank or SBI VC Trade.

relationship_map.relationship: Former 50/50 Centre Consortium ownership; Circle acquired Coinbase's remaining 50% in 2023.
relationship_map.consideration: Circle's SEC S-1 describes approximately $209.9M total consideration in approximately 8.4M Circle Class A shares.
limits: The share count is a 2025 filing snapshot, not a verified November 2026 current position.
The $209.9M Centre consideration was stock consideration, not $209.9M of new cash paid by Coinbase.
relationship_map.post_ipo_position_note: Circle SEC S-1 beneficial-ownership table, after the offering and before any underwriter option exercise.

relationship_map.relationship: 2023 Collaboration Agreement and 2024 Stablecoin Ecosystem Agreement govern USDC distribution and related economics.
relationship_map.economics: Circle pays Coinbase a distribution/revenue share linked to reserve income and USDC balances across Coinbase and approved third-party distribution channels.

binance_participant.status: historical_2024_terms_in_2025_S1; Circle and Binance announced a separate expanded five-year partnership in 2026
binance_participant.agreement_term: Two years from 2024-11-14, subject to amendments or extensions not established here.
binance_participant.limitation: Do not treat the 2024 two-year participant term or upfront incentive as the current 2026 Binance agreement; exact contractual reconciliation is not disclosed in the press release.

limits: USDC distribution share is a dated 2025 snapshot, not a current November 2026 balance.
The Binance incentive is a distribution arrangement, not an XRP purchase or proof of current Binance USDC holdings.
relationship_map.renewal_status: Coinbase's Q3 2026 Form 10-Q states that its arrangement with Circle was renewed on the same terms.
relationship_map.reserve_control: Circle is responsible for managing USDC reserves; Coinbase's distribution/revenue rights do not establish Coinbase control or consolidation of reserve assets.

coinbase_q3_2026.average_usdc_held_in_coinbase_products: all-time high, exact average not disclosed in the cited 10-Q narrative

relationship_map.from: SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank
relationship_map.relationship: Direct Circle IPO equity investment.
limits: This is Circle equity capital, not an XRP purchase and not USDC reserve capital.

relationship_map.relationship: SBI Group publicly described itself as Ripple's largest external shareholder.
limits: The 9% figure is dated to the SBI disclosure; no current November 2026 cap-table confirmation was found.
Ripple equity ownership is not ownership of 9% of XRP supply and is not a $10B XRP-token holding.

relationship_map.relationship: SBI Ripple Asia joint venture.
limits: The ownership split is from the cited SBI presentation vintage; current cap-table changes were not independently rechecked.

relationship_map.relationship: RLUSD trading/distribution in Japan.
limits: RLUSD is Ripple's dollar stablecoin, not XRP.
Listing/distribution does not establish RLUSD trading volume, XRP purchases or XRPL settlement volume.

relationship_map.from: SBI Ripple Asia and dsrv labs
relationship_map.relationship: Research into Japan–Korea remittance use cases with XRPL as the assumed ledger.
limits: No production settlement volume or XRP bridge-asset usage was established.

relationship_map.relationship: Ripple DLT used in Japan–Thailand and Japan–Vietnam remittance corridors.
limits: The cited SBI Remit materials describe Ripple DLT; they do not by themselves prove XRP was used as the bridge asset for every transfer.

relationship_map.from: SBI Shinsei Bank and SBI VC Trade
relationship_map.relationship: Joint retail promotion: six-month yen term deposit at 0.70% annual rate with an XRP voucher worth up to JPY 20,000, subject to campaign conditions.
limits: The deposit remains yen-denominated; the XRP voucher is a separate promotion.
No voucher redemption count, XRP acquisition source or market execution data was disclosed.

relationship_map.relationship: A June 10 pilot converting a portion (reported as 20%) of deposit interest into crypto vouchers was described by Nikkei and repeated in a podcast.
relationship_map.primary_confirmation: No matching primary SBI Shinsei Bank announcement was located in the public sources reviewed.
limits: Do not conflate this reported pilot with the separate February 2, 2026 official JPY 20,000 XRP-voucher campaign.
The podcast guest said she was not fully up to date on the Japan program; it is not independent confirmation.

relationship_map.relationship: SBI investor presentation documents historical XRP shareholder-benefit distributions.
limits: A shareholder reward is not a corporate XRP treasury purchase or evidence of market-buy volume.

relationship_map.from: SBI VC Trade / SBI card ecosystem
relationship_map.relationship: Crypto card rewards can be converted into BTC, ETH or XRP through an SBI VC Trade account.
limits: Points conversion is not evidence of new XRP purchases by the issuing bank or card network.

relationship_map.from: SBI Shinsei Trust Bank, SBI VC Trade and Startale
relationship_map.relationship: Trust-based yen stablecoin issued by SBI Shinsei Trust Bank, distributed and supported by SBI VC Trade, co-developed with Startale, with SBI Shinsei Bank in the group structure.
limits: JPYSC is a yen stablecoin, not XRP, RLUSD or USDC.
The lending and handling balances are issuer/group-reported product metrics; they are not XRP demand or proof of public-chain circulation.
Initial service availability was described within SBI VC Trade accounts, with broader public-chain availability dependent on legal/tax readiness.

relationship_map.relationship: RLUSD made available through Coinbase app, Prime and Exchange with XRPL, Base and Ethereum deposit/withdrawal support.
relationship_map.collateral_status: Coinbase stated that Coinbase Global Exchange collateral support for RLUSD will follow; do not treat it as live at launch.
relationship_map.liquidity_note: Ripple stated it would provide liquidity on Base.
limits: RLUSD is a dollar stablecoin, not XRP.
Listing and network support do not establish XRP spot demand or RLUSD trading volume.

relationship_map.relationship: Ripple Prime clients gained access to Coinbase Derivatives contracts cleared by Nodal Clear, including XRP futures.
limits: This is derivatives access through a clearing/prime-brokerage arrangement, not a Ripple–Coinbase equity partnership or spot-XRP purchase.

relationship_map.relationship: Named custodian for the ETF's XRP holdings in the SEC-filed trust report.
limits: Custody does not disclose Coinbase's XRP inventory or prove that Coinbase itself purchased the ETF's XRP.

relationship_map.relationship: Coinbase Wrapped XRP (cbXRP) is a Base representation backed 1:1 by XRP held in Coinbase custody; Coinbase describes automatic unwrap on deposit and no separate Coinbase order book.
limits: The reserve snapshot is issuer-published and not an independent audit.
The source of reserve XRP is not disclosed; minting cbXRP does not prove a new spot purchase.
cbXRP is custodial wrapped XRP, not native XRP and not a Coinbase Exchange order-book asset.
Coinbase documents regional restrictions, including New York State and Japan.

relationship_map.relationship: Base Markets lists cbXRP/USDC Morpho markets with cbXRP as supported collateral.
limits: The Base Markets page is a dynamic ecosystem market dashboard and did not expose an exact snapshot time.
The displayed market deposits/borrows are not proof of new XRP purchases or Coinbase Global Exchange collateral support.
An 86% collateral factor is a market parameter, not a guaranteed borrower LTV or liquidation price.

relationship_map.relationship: Coinbase digital-asset disclosures mark XRP and cbXRP as held and commercially engaged in the relevant disclosure tables.
limits: The disclosure does not provide asset quantities in the cited table and must not be used as an AUC estimate.

relationship_map.relationship: Both companies have disclosed BNY custody/reserve roles in their respective digital-asset programs.
limits: A shared custodian is not evidence of a direct Circle–Ripple partnership, common ownership or coordinated token issuance.

relationship_map.relationship: Direct $100M equity investment in Circle and expanded/renewed five-year strategic commercial partnership to promote USDC across Binance's global platform, with emphasis on emerging markets.
limits: The announcement does not disclose the exact share count or post-investment ownership percentage.
This is Circle equity and USDC distribution, not XRP ownership, XRP purchases or a Ripple partnership.
The exact contractual relationship to the historical 2024 Binance participant incentives is not fully disclosed.

relationship_map.to: Institutional borrowers and pledged digital assets
relationship_map.relationship: Q3 2026 SEC filing reports collateral requirements generally ranging from 100% to 250% of loan fair value, approximately $997.557M fair value of recognized crypto collateral, and approximately $3.2846B fair value of borrower/customer collateral not recognized on Coinbase's balance sheet.
relationship_map.concentration_note: Three counterparties each represented more than 10% of loan receivables.
relationship_map.asset_specificity: The filing does not disclose an XRP-specific collateral balance; 'other crypto assets' is aggregated.
limits: Do not infer that XRP is a material part of the reported collateral pool.
This institutional lending collateral disclosure is separate from cbXRP/USDC Morpho markets on Base.

relationship_map.relationship: Q3 2026 issuer-reported circulation, reserve, on-chain and payment-network metrics.
limits: Gross $104B minting and $104B redemptions are gross flows, not $208B of net new USDC capital.
The $13.9T on-chain transaction-volume metric is not equivalent to unique economic payments or net settlement value.
The $41.3B CPN TPV is annualized, not realized Q3 volume.
Circle-reported metrics are issuer data, not independently audited XRP demand.

relationship_map.to: Visa Direct, Samsung Wallet, CPN, Tazapay and Arc
relationship_map.relationship: Q3 2026 release describes USDC payment integrations and network expansion: Visa Direct prefunding moved from pilot to commercial deployment through Inyo Global; Samsung Wallet enabled USDC-to-bank transfers in 60+ countries; Tazapay acquisition remained pending; Arc mainnet launched September 16 with native USDC.
limits: Annualized CPN TPV is not realized quarterly volume.
Tazapay acquisition was pending regulatory approval and was not completed in the cited period.
Arc is a separate network and is not XRPL.

indirect_relationships.sbi_coinbase: No direct SBI–Coinbase agreement was established in reviewed sources. SBI's Circle investment and Coinbase's USDC distribution economics create an indirect link through Circle/USDC.
indirect_relationships.circle_ripple: No direct Circle–Ripple partnership was established. Their stablecoins compete and share some institutional service providers, including BNY.
indirect_relationships.sbi_jpysc: SBI Group's yen-stablecoin infrastructure is adjacent to the XRP ecosystem through the same exchange and corporate group, but JPYSC is not XRP or RLUSD.

direct_equity_capital: SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank's $50M Circle IPO investment is equity capital.
SBI's approximately 9% Ripple stake is equity ownership as of the dated SBI disclosure, not XRP-token ownership.
Coinbase's Circle shares were received as stock consideration for the Centre stake; do not classify the $209.9M transaction value as fresh cash paid by Coinbase.
Binance announced a separate $100M equity investment in Circle in September 2026.
not_proven_spot_xrp_purchases: SBI XRP vouchers and shareholder rewards are promotional distributions; redemption and exchange sourcing are undisclosed.
cbXRP reserves prove backing custody, not when or how the underlying XRP was acquired.
cbXRP/USDC Morpho borrow balances are USDC debt against collateral, not XRP purchases.
RLUSD listing and JPYSC issuance are stablecoin distribution, not XRP purchases.
SBI Remit's Ripple DLT use does not prove XRP bridge-asset usage for each remittance.
Circle's $104B gross USDC minting and $104B gross redemptions in Q3 are gross stablecoin flows, not net new capital and not XRP purchases.
Coinbase's reported institutional collateral pool is not XRP-specific; no XRP balance can be inferred from the aggregate.
actual_capital_classification.previously_verified_evernorth_distinctio: The separate Evernorth filing records approximately $214M historical cash used for XRP purchases, approximately 388.9M XRP contributed in kind, and separate financing. These categories must not be combined as cash spot purchases.
